page_title: LIV 3-1 CRY | Liverpool v Crystal Palace 25/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' 3 - 1 Sensational! Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the left post and in the net. The assist goes to Alexis Mac Allister and the score changes to 3:1.
90+3' Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
87' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Andrew Robertson is replaced by Milos Kerkez (Liverpool).
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is replacing Curtis Jones.
86' It looks like Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) saw red with that tackle. Andy Madley won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.
84' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
82' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is caught offside!
80' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Florian Wirtz, but Dean Henderson displays great awareness to stop him.
79' A substitution has been made. Alexander Isak goes off and Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) comes on.
78' Some great controlled play and passing from Crystal Palace. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
71' Frederick Woodman (Liverpool) picks up an injury.
71' 2 - 1 Goal! Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 2:1.

70' Frederick Woodman pulls off a great save to deny Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jean-Philippe Mateta as he is replaced by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace).
69' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
68' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
68' Liverpool hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
63' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
59' Here is a change. Brennan Johnson is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Salah trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool).
56' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
55' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
52' Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
50' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

48' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

47' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
46' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Tyrick Mitchell will be replaced by Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+4' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Now Crystal Palace have a corner.
45+2' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
45+1' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
45+1' Crystal Palace force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Curtis Jones tees up Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Dean Henderson.
40' Crystal Palace quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Frederick Woodman keeps it out with an amazing save.

35' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexis Mac Allister plays in Alexander Isak (Liverpool), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top right corner of the net! Great finish - 1:0.
32' This is a yellow card! Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

32' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
31' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
30' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the corner.
30' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
27' Liverpool are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
24' NO PENALTY! Referee Andy Madley has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Liverpool players are incensed.
24' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Liverpool, he's going to review using VAR.
23' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Andy Madley signals a foul. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Liverpool!!
22' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just inches over the bar.
19' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
15' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Andy Madley who sees an offensive foul.
12' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
10' Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
8' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) launches a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is alert to thwart the effort.

7' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
6' A quickly taken corner by Liverpool.
6' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Liverpool will take a corner kick.
4' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Curtis Jones (Liverpool). Andy Madley saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
3' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
2' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) takes it short.
2' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andy Madley.
